decision: D-049 (the user: "Approve as recommended"), on T-025f's escalations E-1, E-3 and E-5
status: post hoc to docs/L7V2_DESIGN.md and to the earlier pre-registrations, before any P1 data and before the code it judges

halving.modelled_on: ml/p4_traffic.py halve and browser_devices, docs/P4_SLOW_DESIGN.md's rule
halving.when: before the harm ladder, on a pilot seed only, never on an evaluation seed

health.judge: eval/harm_gate.py control_health on each of the two controls
health.q_min_source: the record's gate.control_q_min, and CONTROL_CLASS_Q_MIN, both unchanged

halving.step: halvings + 1, both controls again on the same seed, so that only the mix moves
halving.stop: the first step counting up from 0 whose two controls are sound and healthy: its halvings is the factor. No step runs after it
halving.unsound: a control whose run checks fail gives no reading and fires nothing: the step is repeated at the same halvings, at most max_reruns times, the record's gate.max_reruns; past that the rule refuses
halving.halved: every benign spec of count > 1 keeps max(1, count >> halvings) entities, the first of its list; the others are dropped from every run
halving.never_removed: a spec of count 1: both CGNAT pools, the NAT gateway and each single-entity kind, so that FP per benign kind keeps every kind
halving.entity_stability: an entity keeps its index, sub-seed, address and parameters whatever the halvings: a halved plan is the full plan without the dropped entities, and the attack's addresses do not move

floor.why: my choice, under D-049. At 2 halvings the two CGNAT pools hold 36 of about 81 benign users and the flash crowd has 7 devices; at 3 they would hold 36 of about 65, a majority, the crowd would have 3 and the mix would no longer be a mix of mostly single-user clients
floor.disclosed: a halving raises the share of users behind the pools, 20 % at the full mix, 32 % at 1, 44 % at 2, so a flagged pool costs a larger share of the budget's users (D-043). The factor is reported with every result

halving.at_the_floor: still unhealthy at max_halvings: there is no factor. The ladder and the campaign refuse and say so; going on is a new decision, not a further step of this rule
halving.frozen_with: the factor is written in a record-bound health file; the ladder and the campaign read it from there, the knees must name the same factor, and it applies to every block of both. A smoke run may plan any halvings up to the floor and judges nothing

age_check.p3: arrivals.age_check (ml/l7v2_prereg.json) stays enforced on P3's training, validation and held-out captures, unchanged
age_check.p1: on P1's one-slot runs it is recorded per run and not applied: it refuses nothing and invalidates nothing
age_check.reading: the age-only reading on the U replays stands beside every view-level contrast of the analysis output: the window-age AUC of the U runs and the age-only arm's recall at its frozen point. It is descriptive: the verdict's inputs and its ladder do not read it

readings.accepted: T-025f's readings stand, labelled in docs/L7V2_DESIGN.md's As-built section
readings.profiles: the tolerant profile under HGB, GRU and R*; the default profile only in the default rules arm

assumptions.side_bots: [ASSUMPTION] 10 side bots each at M1, M3 and M2exp in every C3b run; they judge nothing
assumptions.file_sink_silence_s: [ASSUMPTION] 10 s: a run whose file sink is silent for longer is invalid
